r_precision_at_k_methodology_note.canonical_r_precision_at_k_csv: results/gbdt/data/r_precision_at_k.csv  (per-cell rows × K in {1,3,5,10,20}, plus AUC + base_rate)

name: xgboost_a6_replication

metric_methodology.primary: weighted R-precision (per-day variable K = R(d), sum(positives_caught)/sum(R(d)), panel-invariant)
metric_methodology.calibration_gate: conditional_isotonic, Spiegelhalter |Z| on val; |Z| < 2.0 ships native, else isotonic

tolerance_reasoning: Conclusions gate, not metric-match gate. XGBoost HP ceiling != CatBoost HP ceiling, so exact AUC/R-prec differ. Require: same signal/null verdict, AUC same side of [0.45,0.55] null band (or both inside for the cross-market cell whose CatBoost AUC was already in-band), weighted R-precision lift comparable magnitude+direction (~within 15% relative), calibration outcome class analogous (|Z| is backend-specific).

calibration.spiegelhalter_z_note: 5.93 raw pre-stop; flip is a tree-count side effect per _147 memo

nifty50_up_10pct_25d_dd5pct.a6_notes: AUC both well above null band; R-prec lift 2.04x vs 2.12x (test), 1.97x vs 2.18x (eval); both fire calibration on the prevalence-drift cell (train 0.28 -> eval 0.13). Verdicts match.

catboost.verdict: SIGNAL (top-tail hidden by null test AUC)

xgboost.verdict: SIGNAL (top-tail hidden by null test AUC)

nasdaq100_up_10pct_25d_dd5pct.a6_notes: Both: test AUC inside [0.45,0.55] null band, eval AUC above it. Test individually ambiguous under compound rule (lift 1.2-1.5x); eval decisive (lift ~2x). Verdict structure identical. Calibration DIFFERS (CatBoost native z=1.59 / XGBoost isotonic z=10.33) — backend-native-surface property the conditional-isotonic gate is designed to absorb; isotonic is order-preserving so cross-cell ranking comparable is unchanged. Within tolerance.

calibration_divergence_flag.description: CatBoost ships native (val |Z|=1.59), XGBoost ships isotonic (val |Z|=10.33). XGBoost binary:logistic + depthwise growth produces sharper/over-confident raw probabilities; CatBoost Ordered-boosting + symmetric trees produces near-calibrated raw. The gate responds to each backend's own native surface. Calibrated ranking (weighted R-precision on p_calibrated) matches; isotonic monotone => no per-day reorder => ranking conclusion unchanged.
calibration_divergence_flag.classification: expected backend property, not a backend bug
